notes.title: BETA Update v.7.1
notes.content:
Changelogs:



Level 1: Prisonbreak

fixed some cases of floating blood.



Level 2: Rescue Mohammedland

Fixed some cases of missing colldiers on some of the props.



Mohammed

Fixed many cases of UI text not being centered. 



General

Changed the discord link on the store page and on the main menu to the new one

notes.title: BETA Update v.7.0
notes.content:
Changelogs:



Level 6: Race for Key:

New level! 

Race for a key on a beach map against 11 GDkids.  

New and improved driving mechanics, including (but not limited) to: nitro, cinematic cam, improved general driving controls etc  



Level 3: Destroy GD land:

Fixed a bug where the timer doesnt show up when you select speedrun difficulty 



GDmods

Added death sounds to GDmods and its variants. 



Menus

Added "are you sure?" panels for each time you want to restart/exit a level/map. 



Steam

Added references to level 6 to the store page.

notes.title: BETA Update v.6.4
notes.content:
Changelogs:



Level 5: Defend Yourself

Updated the spawnrates of enemies to be more balanced.

RopTob's pod now plays his theme. 



Level 4: Slender GDkid

The car now faintly plays vroom vroom.



Level 3: Destroy GD land

Updated the spawnrates of enemies to be more balanced.

RopTob's pod now plays his theme.

 

Level 2: Rescue mohammedland

The car now faintly plays vroom vroom before you enter it.



Arena

Changed the spawn system, arena now starts off spawning easy enemies and then progressively spawns harder and harder enemies.

notes.title: BETA Update v.6.3
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Joey

 Made it so Joey's bullets no longer damage Mohammed.


Arena

 Changed so a wave ends instantly once you have killed the last enemy, instead of a delay.


GDkids/GDmods

 Added a setting to keep ragdolls on the map, instead of deleting them after 10 seconds.


Steam

 Added 2 more achievements related to level 5.

notes.title: BETA Update v.6.2
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Level 5: Defend Yourself

 Added difficulties: Normal, Hard, Impossible and Speedrunner.


Mohammed

 Fixed issues relating with sensitivity and AWP scoping.
 Fixed various issues relating with animations and mohammed not pressing down on triggers
 Fixed various issues of weapon switch UI getting stuck on screen in levels.


Steam

 Added 4 more achievements related to level 5.

notes.title: BETA Update v.6.1
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Arena

 New map! map 5: Defend yourself


Level 5: Defend Yourself

 Fixed some cases of bullets bouching off various props.


Mohammed

 Fixed a bug where you could scope whilst in the pause menu.


Menus

 Added m249 shots and AWP shots to the statistics

notes.title: BETA Update v.6.0
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Level 5: Defend Yourself

 New level!
 Defend yourself with Joey against a whole bunch of geometry dabbers trying to rescue RopTob.
 2 new weapons added: M249 machine gun and AWP sniper rifle.
 New enemy variant added: Green GD kid, that explodes upon death, and if explodes right next to you, insta kills you. 


Arena

 Added the M249 and AWP to all arena mode maps.
 Added the Green GD kid to all arena mode maps.


Mohammed

 You can now hold jump and continuously jump.
 Added an image to indicate whether you were crouched or not.


Level 1: Prisonbreak

 Fixed a visual bug with the keypad door.


Steam

 Added references to level 5 to the store page.

notes.title: BETA Update v.5.6
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Mohammed

 RPG blasts will now shake the screen a bit.
 Nerfed the RPG a bit so it doesn't kill blue gd kids instantly. 


Menus

 Added precentages and numbers to each slider in the game.


Arena

 Fixed various cases of bullets bounching off props in map3.


General

 Made the game play and feel smoother.


Steam

 Made a new trailer for the game's store page.

notes.title: BETA Update v.5.5
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Mohammed

 Added FOV settings.
 Added more hurt, death, heal and win sounds.


GDMods

 Fixed a bug where if a bullet fired by a gdmod hit your rocket/bullet it would explode/bouce off.


Arena

 Fixed many cases of bullets bounching off various props in map 1.

notes.title: BETA Update v.5.4
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Menus

 Fixed the enable music button
 Made it harder to accidently reset your stats.
 Added a "Disable background music" button to the ingame settings, that does what the name suggests.
 Added a music volume slider to the settings to adjust the volume of the main menu music
 Added a game volume slider to the ingame settings to adjust the volume of the game.
 Made the hover effects over levels/maps have a fade effect between them.


General

 Fixed many cases of the ai breaking if you reach slightly higher elevation in many maps.

notes.title: BETA Update v.5.3
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Mohammed

 Removed the fists' instantiate animation.


Arena

 Fixed a bug where you can't win once beating 20 waves.


Menus

 Added checkmarks for if you beat all diffulties in a level or beat all 20 maps in an arena map.
 Improved the made with unity splash screen
 In the levels and arena menus if you hover over the buttons it will change the background to the level.


General

 Changed the games names in the files and in the windows from "My project" to "Geometry Dabs - Save the World BETA"
 Changed the taskbar logo from unity logo to geometry dabs logo

notes.title: BETA Update v.5.2
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Level 4: Slender GDkid

 Changed so that the level's sensitivity settings is seperate from all other level's sensitivity.


Mohammed

 Fixed a visual bug with the ak's reload animation where mohammeds hands go through the gun briefly.
 Made the damage overlay less annoying.


Menus

 Removed the unity skybox from all cutscenes and menus


General

 Reduced the file size of the game a bit

notes.title: BETA Update v.5.1
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Level 4: Slender GDkid

 Added difficulties: Normal, Hard, Impossible and Speedrunner
 Fixed a bug where the ui doesn't scale with screen size
 Fixed a bug where audio fucks up/doesnt pause if you restart level/quit to main menu


Menus

 Simplified the main menu a bit.


Steam

 Added 6 more achievements related to Level 4

notes.title: BETA Update v.5.0
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Level 4: Slender GDkid

 New level!
 Collect all 6 documents whilst avoiding the slender GDkid.


Level 3: Destroy Geometry Dabs Land

 Changed impossible mode, made it 1% health, faster gd kids and no health kits like previous levels.


Level 2: Rescue Mohammedland

 Decorated the huts with mohammed paintings.


Mohammed

 Fixed a visual glitch with the AK that occurs when you run.


Menus

 Changed the 1% random main menu bg music to be 18 different songs instead of 1.
 Added a "reset all stats" button to the settings that resets statistics, checkmarks and best times.


Steam

 Added 2 more achievements related to level 3.
 Fixed a bug where you cant get achievements on a different steam account if you already got them on another one.
 Updated the store page with references to level 4

notes.title: BETA Update v.4.2
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Level 3: Destroy Geometry Dabs Land

 Added difficulties to Level 3, Normal, hard, Impossible and Speedrunner.
 Added a view distance slider. 
 Fixed a visual bug where if you enter the cutscene with a weaponui on screen, it gets stuck.


Arena mode

 Made the fence in map 4 higher.


Steam

 Added 4 more achievements related to level 3.

notes.title: BETA Update v.4.1
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Level 3: Destroy Geometry Dabs Land

 Fixed a bug where the pods destroyed text wouldn't reset if you restart the level/go back to menu then play level again.
 Fixed a bug where going out of bounds and then entering the car fucks the whole game up.
 Changed so that each spawnpod can only spawn a max of 20 enemies. 
 Fixed a bug where you could destroy the pods from any distance with fists aslong as you hit an enemy in the range of it.
 Optimized the level a bit more.


Arena Mode

 New map! map 4: Destroy Geometry Dabs Land.
 Fixed a bug where all the arena maps would restart to map 1 and go back to map 1 menu when you exit. 
 Fixed so that all arena mode maps play the correct background music.


Mohammed

 Lowered the volume on the rocket explosion.


Menus

 Fixed a bug where you could fire the RPG in the pause menu.

notes.title: BETA Update v.4.0
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Level 3: Destroy Geometry Dabs Land

 New level!
 Added a new weapon: The RPG, select it by pressing 3.
 Added a new friendly NPC that helps Mohammed out and follows him: Joey
 Added destructable buildings that get destroyed once they get hit with the RPG.
 And more!


Arena Mode

 Added the RPG to every single arena mode map.


Mohmamed

 Added inspiring quotes that appear when you die.


Menus

 Added "rockets fired" stat tracker to the statistics
 Changed "Highest wave reached" to "Highest wave survived" because that's what it is.
 Changed the rare 1% todd picture to be 82 different todd pictures including the previous one that change each time you get the 1% chance.


Steam

 Edited the steam store page to include refrences to level 3.

notes.title: BETA Update v.3.4
notes.content:
Changelogs:

Level 2: Rescue Mohammedland

 Fixed a bug where restarting the level doesn't work inside the mansion part of the level.
 Fixed a bug where dying at the keypad or quiz would make you be able to move.
 Lowered the delay to enter the quiz by half.
 Fixed various cases of the roof sticking out of the huts in the level.


Mohammed

 Changed so that the objective text is in front of the damage overlay.
 Removed the ak's initialize animation because of issues caused by it.


Menus

 Added a highest wave reached tracker to the statistics.

notes.title: BETA Update v.3.3
notes.content:
Change logs

Level 2: Rescue Mohammedland

 Fixed a bug where restarting the level doesn't work
 Fixed many cases of being able to see the void through the cliffs and such
 Fixed the enemies being able to walk through various props.


GDmod

 Added another gdmod variant, blue gdmod, who has changes to his stats and what not. Currently only appears in arena mode maps.


Menus

 Removed the wiki from the main menu
 Added statistics that keep track of various stuff you do in the game.


General

 Enabled v-sync for low quality settings to fix a bug where the mouse makes random sudden movements.

notes.title: BETA Update v.3.2
notes.content:
Change logs

Level 2: Rescue Mohammedland

 Fixed a bug where if you go into the car, then exit or restart using the pause menu enemies would ignore you and whatever.
 Added difficulties to Level 2.


GDmod

 Added 2 GDmod variants, pink gd mod and red gd mod. Both have changes to their stats and whatever. Currently they only appear in arena mode maps.


Steam

 Added 12 more achievement, 6 achievements related to level 2 and 6 related to Arena mode.

notes.title: BETA Update v.3.1
notes.content:
Change logs

Level 2: Rescue Mohammedland

 Fixed a bug where the carUI wouldn't scale with screen size
 Fixed a bug where the gdkids could kill you whilst you are in the car
 Fixed a bug where the enemies could walk through different props
 Changed so that if you die in the quiz, you automatically exit it
 You can now pause whilst in the car


Arena mode

 Added a new map, map 3: Rescue Mohammedland
 Fixed a bug where if you go into a difficulty in the levels then exit the difficulty the effects still affect stuff in arena. 


GDmod

 Added more idle sounds


Menus

 Changed the available levels graphic

notes.title: BETA Update v.3.0
notes.content:
Change logs

Level 2: Rescue Mohammedland

 New level with new map and everything!
 Added car, quiz and a bunch of other new stuff.


Arena mode

 Removed the countdown before next wave, you can now start next wave by pressing J once you have completed the current wave.
 Fixed a bug where the background music wouldnt cut off when pausing in arena mode maps.
 Mohammed's ak current magazine ammo will now show in the bottom right corner.


GDkids

 Added 3 variant GDkids, black gd kid, blue gd kid and white gd kid. All of them have some changes to their stats. Currently they only appear in arena mode and level 2. Blue gd kid will NOT appear in map 2: prisonbreak arena map.
 Removed the 1% chance of the gdkid ignoring you thanks to issues caused by it.


GDMod

 Disabled collisions between GDmod and mohammed.


General

 Fixed resolution bugs that would cut off ui elements.


Steam

 Edited the steam store page to include refrences to level 2.

notes.title: BETA update v.2.0
notes.content:
Change logs

Arena mode

 New gamemode! Arena mode - Survive against waves of Geometry Dabs enemies for as long as you can. Max 20 waves.
 New enemy introduced - GDMod.
 2 maps for arena mode - New map called "arena" and another map called prisonbreak, which is a changed version of the main area in level 1: Prisonbreak.

Keypad

 You can now remove the previous digit you put with backspace.

Steam

 Updated the steam store to include references to arena mode.

notes.title: BETA update v1.7
notes.content:
Change logs

Map1: Prisonbreak

 Fixed a bug where you could enter the keypad whilst dying


Menus

 Fixed a weird bug with the enable music switch in settings, now the music will always play when u exit a level as the main menu songs are bangers and you should listen to them atleast for a bit, then u can redisable them.
 Added a button in the main menu that you can use to access the Geometry Dabs - Save The World fandom wiki
 Added "best time" next to the speedrun button in the Difficulty Select screen that keeps track of the best time you have achieved on speedrunner difficulty
 Added checkmarks that will appear next to difficulties everytime you have completed one of the difficulties. 


Steam

 Added 10 Achievements

notes.title: BETA update v1.6
notes.content:
Change logs

Map 1: Prisonbreak

 Speedrunner's timer is now visable in the keypad
 Removed all ammo boxes in impossible mode as it's not needed


Menus

 In speedrunner mode, restart level will restart the level only not play the cutscene
 Added a disable music button in the settings of the main menus that will disable the bg music playing


General

 Improved the file size of the game


Steam

 Added 2 achievements

notes.title: BETA update v.1.5
notes.content:
Change logs


Map1: Prisonbreak

 Fixed various cases of floating objects/objects you can phase through
 You can now execute using enter and exit using escape in the keypad
 Added the ability to pick difficulty, you can now choose to play the map normally, hard mode, impossible mode or speedrunner mode.


Mohammed

 Fixed a bug where the fists would get stuck in a certain pose if you switch whilst attacking
 Fixed a bug where the weapon ui would get stuck on screen if you pause too quick
 When you die/win the ammo and popupInfo will disappear now
 If you press J, mohammed will say sab to mohammed now
 Fixed a bug where you could switch weapons in the keypad


GDKid

 Fixed a bug where if shot from afar the gdkid would glitch out
 Added more idle phrases
 Added a 0.1% chance gdkid dies if they see you
